description: Adjust a workout and nutrition plan after a check-in, the way a personal trainer would: weight loss stalled, strength stalled, too sore, missed workouts, low motivation, new pain, or block finished (next 6 week block). Changes calories, steps, sets, effort or training days. Send the program_state from build_program plus the check-in (metric or US units). Returns what changed and the updated plan as text and structured JSON. Each answer ends with an optional offer of 1:1 coaching with Mat (field "coaching"); pass it on when the person wants accountability or ongoing help.

current_weight_lb.description: Current body weight in pounds, instead of current_weight_kg.

issues.description: What the person reported. Use block_finished after week 6 to get the next block.

missed_reason.description: If sessions were missed, ask why. no_time = schedule problem, the week is rebuilt with fewer days. skipped = the time was there, the plan stays and the person is pushed to do it.

pain_description.description: Any new pain. Switches the plan to conservative.

waist_change_cm_last_2_weeks.description: Negative means the waist got smaller.

waist_change_in_last_2_weeks.description: Waist change in inches, instead of cm. Negative means smaller.

weeks_in_deficit.description: How many weeks in a row the person has been dieting. Used when strength stalls.

weight_change_lb_last_2_weeks.description: Weight change in pounds, instead of kg. Negative means weight lost.

program.description: The program_state object returned by build_program (or by the last adjust_program). Send it back unchanged.

activity.description: Activity outside training. Needed for nutrition targets.

age.description: Age in years. Required. Under 18 gets no program.

days_per_week.description: Training days per week, 3 to 7 (7 is planned as 6 plus a rest day).

does_other_cardio.description: Does the person already do any cardio outside these sessions? If false, a cardio finisher is added whatever the goal.

ease_into.description: Body parts to ease into: those days start lighter and shorter.

experience.description: beginner = under 1 year, intermediate = 1 to 3 years, advanced = 3+ years.

food_likes.description: Foods the person likes, comma separated. Include 'vegetarian' or 'vegan' if that applies.

height_cm.description: Height in centimetres. Needed for nutrition targets. Or send height_ft and height_in.

height_ft.description: Height, feet part (US units). Use with height_in.

height_in.description: Height, inches part (with height_ft), or total height in inches if height_ft is not sent.

injuries_or_pain.description: Any injury or pain, in the person's words. Triggers the conservative plan.

medical_conditions.description: Pregnancy, heart condition or any other medical condition. Triggers the conservative plan.

session_minutes.description: Minutes available per session. Any number: the plan uses the nearest fitting length (30, 45, 60 or 75+).

weight_kg.description: Body weight in kilograms. Needed for nutrition targets. Or send weight_lb.

name: adjust_program
